metadata.name: ww-openstreetmap-leaflet
metadata.description: Interactive Leaflet map using OpenStreetMap tiles by default, with markers, circles, polygons and click events. The default provider requires no key.
features: Static or bound marker and shape arrays
Map, marker and shape click workflows

properties.name: tileLayer
properties.description: A leaflet-providers preset. Use OpenStreetMap.Mapnik for a map that needs no provider key.

properties.name: lat
properties.description: Initial latitude in decimal degrees.

properties.name: lng
properties.description: Initial longitude in decimal degrees.

properties.name: zoom
properties.description: Initial whole-number zoom level. Stay within the selected provider’s supported range.

properties.name: zoomControl
properties.description: Displays the Leaflet zoom buttons.

properties.name: attributionControl
properties.description: Displays tile attribution. Keep enabled when using OpenStreetMap tiles.

properties.name: markers
properties.description: Marker objects with data: [latitude, longitude]. Optional tooltip, tooltipContent, tooltipDirection and tooltipPermanent control the label. Use user-approved URLs if setting customIcon and iconUrl.

properties.name: circles
properties.description: Circle objects with data: [latitude, longitude] and radius in metres. Optional Leaflet path style properties include color, weight, fillColor and fillOpacity.

properties.name: polygons
properties.description: Polygon objects with data: [[latitude, longitude], …]. Provide at least three positions. Supports Leaflet path styling.

properties.name: markerDataField
properties.description: Property path for coordinates in a bound marker row. Use data when rows have the shape shown in the example.

properties.name: circleDataField
properties.description: Property path for coordinates in a bound circle row. Use data for the example row shape.

properties.name: circleRadiusField
properties.description: Property path for the radius in a bound circle row. Use radius for the example row shape.

properties.name: polygonDataField
properties.description: Property path for the coordinate array in a bound polygon row. Use data for the example row shape.

properties.name: markers_tooltipContentField
properties.description: For a bound marker label, map this property to the row field containing the tooltip text, such as tooltipContent.

properties.name: circles_tooltipContentField
properties.description: For a bound circle label, map this property to the row field containing the tooltip text, such as tooltipContent.

properties.name: circles_colorField
properties.description: Map the color style of a bound circle to its row field, such as color.

properties.name: circles_weightField
properties.description: Map the weight style of a bound circle to its row field, such as weight.

properties.name: circles_fillColorField
properties.description: Map the fillColor style of a bound circle to its row field, such as fillColor.

properties.name: circles_fillOpacityField
properties.description: Map the fillOpacity style of a bound circle to its row field, such as fillOpacity.

properties.name: polygons_tooltipContentField
properties.description: For a bound polygon label, map this property to the row field containing the tooltip text, such as tooltipContent.

properties.name: polygons_colorField
properties.description: Map the color style of a bound polygon to its row field, such as color.

properties.name: polygons_weightField
properties.description: Map the weight style of a bound polygon to its row field, such as weight.

properties.name: polygons_fillColorField
properties.description: Map the fillColor style of a bound polygon to its row field, such as fillColor.

properties.name: polygons_fillOpacityField
properties.description: Map the fillOpacity style of a bound polygon to its row field, such as fillOpacity.

events.name: map:click
events.description: Runs when the map is clicked.

events.name: map:zoom
events.description: Runs after the map zoom changes.

events.name: map:move
events.description: Runs after the map stops moving.

events.name: marker:click
events.description: Runs when a marker is clicked. The marker contains the original row.

events.name: shape:click
events.description: Runs when a circle or polygon is clicked.

specifications: Use [latitude, longitude] for all coordinates. Keep latitude and longitude as strings in content.default.lat and content.default.lng.
Give the element an explicit height. Its Leaflet container needs a nonzero height to display the map.

For a bound layer array, return rows with the same data and radius keys as the static example so they also work in the published app. In the same content.default object set markerDataField, circleDataField or polygonDataField to the string data for each bound layer you use, and set circleRadiusField to the string radius for bound circles.

To display bound tooltips in the editor and published app, give rows tooltip: true and tooltipContent, and set the corresponding markers_tooltipContentField, circles_tooltipContentField or polygons_tooltipContentField to the string tooltipContent. For a bound circle or polygon, map each style field you use to the matching row property, such as circles_colorField to color.
Generate tooltip content as plain trusted text. Do not insert raw user-provided HTML in map tooltips.
Use the default provider and keep attribution on unless the user specifies another compatible provider.

examples.description: OpenStreetMap centered on Paris with a marker, a circle and a polygon.
